hypothesis.statement: On a real eyes-closed posterior EEG channel (eegmmidb S002R02, POz), the shipped PhysioMoCap sampleEntropy and approximateEntropy (m=2, r=0.2*SD) reproduce BOTH antropy AND NeuroKit2 BIT-FOR-BIT; and sample entropy exceeds approximate entropy (ApEn is biased low by the self-matches it counts).

analysis_plan.dataset: EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database (eegmmidb, PhysioNet), subject S002, baseline run R02 (eyes-closed), channel POz (posterior), first 10 s at 160 Hz (1600 samples)

decision.threshold: descriptive: sampleEntropy and approximateEntropy each equal antropy AND NeuroKit2 to machine precision (max |diff| < 1e-9 vs each)
